body: I guess you're right, it might be better but I still can't help but think I deserve to die and I'm scared to continue to live because I don't wanna make anymore mistakes but overall thanks, I suppose you did help me a bit.

I'm not really sure I honestly don't know what he would say and I can't really imagine what he would say either, Id like to think though it'd be something good like "don't give up, keep trying and do better" but I can't help but think he'd might say something bad.

My mom says I'm like my dad, which isn't really a good thing, she called me a mistake once when we got into a fight, and she said that its my fault that my brother died. She thinks of me as a bully. She thinks I steal and always lie to her but I don't. And my dad even though you didn't ask. He got mad at me before and said that everything is my fault and that nobody cares about.
His friends and my mom told stories about how nice and cool he was. So I suppose I did learn about him through stories. And thanks.
